question.text: An equilateral triangle is made by uniform wires $A B, B C, C A .$ A current $I$ enters at $A$ and leaves from the mid point of $B C$. If the lengths of each side of the triangle is $L,$ the magnetic field $B$ at the centroid $O$ of the triangle is

solution.text: The given situation can be shown as The magnetic field at centroid $O$ = Magnetic field due to left part + Magnetic field due to right part $\therefore$ $$ \mathrm{B}=\mathrm{B}_{1}+\mathrm{B}_{2}=0 $$ (: direction of $B$ due to both parts is different of $O$ )
